why: I compared each check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Check 1 only asks for the greeting for the given name in upper case; the exact `HELLO, ADA!` plus newline and exit status 0 are under Advisory. Check 2 compares head with base exactly, and that is what "unchanged" means. Check 3 asks that docs/index.md mention --shout and say what it does, which is what "documents" requires. Check 4 can't see the live page before merge, so it checks that the head's workflow still publishes docs/ and that docs/ lists --shout. The specific step names appear only in the Run line, not in PASS or FAIL. This is the closest thing to stricter wording, since a removed workflow fails even if Pages could publish another way. But this workflow is the thing that publishes the page, so I judged it within the words. The stricter items (flag after the name, tests, greeting() return value, changes outside the four files) are all under Advisory.
